_comment: macOS builds whose AMDRadeonVADriver2 was validated. Installing on an UNLISTED build is blocked by default (GPU-hang risk) and needs the explicit override (install/decoders.sh install --force). Add a build only after checking its driver: the same driverUUID (the LC_UUID of AMDRadeonVADriver2) as a listed build means the same binary; a new UUID needs the decode path compared first, and must also be added to kValidatedDrivers in decode/av1/vcnav1.c and decode/vp9/vcnvp9.c (install/check_lists.sh fails when the lists differ). av1/vp9: true = decoded bit-exact on a GPU, "untested-on-gpu" = driver validated but not run yet, false = the plug-in refuses this driver and macOS falls back to software. legacy: the MPEG-2, VC-1 and MPEG-4 plug-ins, which share one list (kValidatedDrivers in decode/common/vcnlegacy.c) and are installed only with install/decoders.sh --legacy; same values as av1/vp9. encode: true = the optional encoding fix (VCNEncodeFix) was validated on this build (its AMDRadeonVADriver2, AppleGVAHEVCEncoder and AMDRadeonX6000HWLibs / AMDRadeonX6800HWLibs match the patched builds); false = it stays off.
